anchors.en: Cannot judge / prefer not to answer — unscored
anchors.zh: 无法判断／暂不回答——不计分

instructions.en: Read each source statement and indicate agreement from your existing experience or knowledge of yourself. Do not try out the actions described. The source does not specify a recent recall window. If you cannot judge or prefer not to answer, choose the added unscored option. English follows the published 2014 bank; Chinese is a new, unvalidated FermatMind working translation.
instructions.zh: 阅读每条源陈述，按已有经验或对自己的了解选择同意程度，不现场尝试题述行为。原来源没有指定近期回忆期限。无法判断或不愿回答时，可以选择本页新增的不计分选项。英文沿用2014年发表题本；中文是费马新工作译文，尚未验证。

prompt.en: I would notice if someone added 5 grains of salt to my cup of water.
prompt.zh: 如果有人在我的一杯水中加了5粒盐，我会察觉。

prompt.en: I would be able to distinguish different people by their smell.
prompt.zh: 我能够凭气味区分不同的人。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t notice if someone added a spoonful of sugar to my tea.
prompt.zh: 如果有人在我的茶中加了一勺糖，我不会察觉。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be afraid of hurting myself when falling off my bike at high speed.
prompt.zh: 如果高速骑自行车摔下来，我不会害怕自己受伤。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to detect the motion of the blades of a rotating fan even when it is at minimum speed.
prompt.zh: 即使风扇转速最低，我也无法看出转动叶片的运动。

prompt.en: The sound of a piano and a violin playing the same note seems very similar to me.
prompt.zh: 对我来说，钢琴和小提琴演奏同一个音时，声音听起来非常相似。

prompt.en: I would be able to detect if a strawberry was ripe by smell alone.
prompt.zh: 我只凭气味就能判断一颗草莓是否成熟。

prompt.en: I would be able to distinguish milk chocolate and dark chocolate by their taste alone.
prompt.zh: 我只凭味道就能区分牛奶巧克力和黑巧克力。

prompt.en: I cannot tolerate hot showers (above 40°C /105°F).
prompt.zh: 我无法忍受热水淋浴（水温高于40°C／105°F）。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t need an anaesthetic to cope with a dental procedure, such as a cavity-filling.
prompt.zh: 接受补牙等牙科操作时，我不需要麻醉也能应付。

prompt.en: I would have to wait for 10 minutes for a hot drink to cool down before swallowing it, otherwise it would be too hot for me.
prompt.zh: 我必须等热饮冷却10分钟才能咽下，否则对我来说会太烫。

prompt.en: I would be able to visually detect the change in brightness of a light each time a dimmer control moved one notch.
prompt.zh: 调光旋钮每移动一格，我都能看出灯光亮度的变化。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to detect large objects, such as parked cars, clearly on a dark night.
prompt.zh: 在漆黑的夜晚，我无法清楚辨认停着的汽车等大物体。

prompt.en: I would notice if someone added 5 drops of lemon juice to my cup of water.
prompt.zh: 如果有人在我的一杯水中加了5滴柠檬汁，我会察觉。

prompt.en: I would be the last person to detect if something was burning.
prompt.zh: 如果有什么东西烧焦，我会是最后察觉的人。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to feel the vibrations from loud music if I was sitting next to the loud speaker (for example, at a concert).
prompt.zh: 即使坐在扬声器旁边（例如在音乐会上），我也感受不到响亮音乐造成的振动。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to feel a small volume change in music as a difference in vibration on my skin.
prompt.zh: 我无法把音乐音量的微小变化感受为皮肤振动的差别。

prompt.en: I can’t hear the TV when it is quiet, even when other people can.
prompt.zh: 电视声音很小时，我听不见，即使其他人能听见。

prompt.en: I would be able to hear a leaf move if blown by the wind on a quiet street.
prompt.zh: 在安静的街道上，如果一片树叶被风吹动，我能够听见。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to taste the difference between two pieces of dark chocolate.
prompt.zh: 我无法尝出两块黑巧克力之间的差别。

prompt.en: I would be able to taste the difference between two brands of salty potato chips/crisps.
prompt.zh: 我能够尝出两个品牌的咸味薯片之间的差别。

prompt.en: When people are talking the words seem to merge together.
prompt.zh: 人们说话时，那些词听起来似乎混在一起。

prompt.en: I can only look at bright colours for a brief period of time.
prompt.zh: 我只能短时间看鲜亮的颜色。

prompt.en: I would lose my balance very easily if I was standing on one foot with my eyes closed.
prompt.zh: 如果闭着眼睛单脚站立，我会很容易失去平衡。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to smell a barbecue from 60 feet (20 metres) away.
prompt.zh: 我无法从60英尺（20米）外闻到烧烤的气味。

prompt.en: I can’t spin round and round without falling over.
prompt.zh: 我无法连续转圈而不摔倒。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t notice a 10 degree difference in temperature of the weather.
prompt.zh: 天气温度相差10度时，我不会察觉。

prompt.en: I can drink tea/coffee ‘straight’, without needing to add milk or sugar.
prompt.zh: 我可以喝不加奶或糖的纯茶／咖啡。

prompt.en: I can’t hear the bass in music.
prompt.zh: 我听不见音乐中的低音部分。

prompt.en: I would be able to smell the difference between freshly cut grass and uncut grass.
prompt.zh: 我能够闻出刚割过的草与没有割过的草之间的差别。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to feel the label at the back of my shirt even if I thought about it.
prompt.zh: 即使刻意去感受，我也感觉不到衬衫后面的标签。

prompt.en: I can hear electricity humming in the walls.
prompt.zh: 我能听见墙内电流的嗡嗡声。

prompt.en: I notice the flickering of a desktop computer even when it is working properly.
prompt.zh: 即使台式电脑工作正常，我也会察觉它的闪烁。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to tell if milk is off simply by smelling it.
prompt.zh: 我无法只凭气味判断牛奶是否变质。

prompt.en: I would be able to notice a tiny change (for example, 1 degree) in the temperature of the weather.
prompt.zh: 我能够察觉天气温度的细小变化，例如1度。

prompt.en: I would be able to feel a one millimetre cut in my skin.
prompt.zh: 我能够感觉到皮肤上一毫米长的伤口。

prompt.en: I would be able to see the individual blades in a rotating fan even if it was at maximum speed.
prompt.zh: 即使风扇转速最高，我也能看清转动中每片叶片。

prompt.en: I would be able to tell the weight difference between two different coin sizes on the palm of my hand, if my eyes were closed.
prompt.zh: 如果闭上眼睛，我能够凭掌心上的重量区分两种不同大小的硬币。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t get dizzy on a carousel/merry-go-round, even at high speed.
prompt.zh: 即使旋转木马转得很快，我也不会头晕。

prompt.en: I can’t see written words on a page that other people can see.
prompt.zh: 别人能看见的纸上文字，我看不见。

prompt.en: I would be able to distinguish between two oranges purely by their taste.
prompt.zh: 我只凭味道就能区分两个橙子。

prompt.en: I couldn’t distinguish a familiar person and a stranger by their smell.
prompt.zh: 我无法凭气味区分熟悉的人和陌生人。

prompt.en: I couldn’t detect if bread is stale purely by its smell.
prompt.zh: 我无法只凭气味判断面包是否已经不新鲜。

prompt.en: I can’t tell if my clothes are clean or dirty by smell alone.
prompt.zh: 我无法只凭气味判断衣服是干净还是脏了。

prompt.en: I would be able to detect the sound of a vacuum cleaner from any room in a two-storey building.
prompt.zh: 在一栋两层建筑的任何房间里，我都能够听见吸尘器的声音。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t notice the difference between even and uneven ground when driving over it sitting in the back seat of a car.
prompt.zh: 坐在汽车后排经过路面时，我察觉不到平坦与不平坦路面之间的差别。

prompt.en: I would be able to drink a cup of boiling water straight after it had been poured from the kettle.
prompt.zh: 水刚从水壶里倒出、还在沸烫时，我也能够马上喝下一杯。

prompt.en: I couldn’t tell two types of green apples apart purely from their colour.
prompt.zh: 我无法只凭颜色区分两种青苹果。

prompt.en: I would be able to distinguish between an old and a new book by their smell.
prompt.zh: 我能够凭气味区分一本旧书和一本新书。

prompt.en: I would be able to read a street sign from a distance of 100 feet (30 metres).
prompt.zh: 我能够从100英尺（30米）外看清街道标志。

prompt.en: I can’t tell if cars passing me on the street are going at different speeds.
prompt.zh: 我无法判断街上从我身边驶过的汽车速度是否不同。

prompt.en: I would be able to notice if someone added 5 grains of sugar to my glass of water.
prompt.zh: 如果有人在我的一杯水中加了5粒糖，我会察觉。

prompt.en: I would have difficulty seeing a single leaf clearly even on a tree that is close up.
prompt.zh: 即使树离我很近，我也很难看清上面的一片叶子。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t taste if someone added a whole teaspoon of salt to my glass of water.
prompt.zh: 如果有人在我的一杯水中加了整整一茶匙盐，我也尝不出来。

prompt.en: I would be able to feel the elastic holding up my socks if I stop and thought about it.
prompt.zh: 如果停下来刻意感受，我能够感觉到支撑袜子的松紧带。

prompt.en: I can’t taste the difference between ripe and non-ripe fruit.
prompt.zh: 我尝不出成熟和未成熟水果之间的差别。

prompt.en: I would be able to stand on one foot for fifteen seconds without wobbling.
prompt.zh: 我能够单脚站立15秒而不晃动。

prompt.en: I would be able to taste the difference between apparently identical pieces of candy.
prompt.zh: 我能够尝出两块看似完全相同的糖果之间的差别。

prompt.en: I notice the weight and pressure of a hat on my head.
prompt.zh: 我会察觉帽子戴在头上的重量和压力。

prompt.en: I would feel if a single hair touched the back of my hand.
prompt.zh: 如果一根头发碰到我的手背，我会感觉到。

prompt.en: If I was walking along, I would be able to feel a passing truck’s vibrations even if my eyes were closed.
prompt.zh: 走路时，即使闭着眼睛，我也能够感觉到经过的卡车所造成的振动。

prompt.en: I would be able to smell the smallest gas leak from anywhere in the house.
prompt.zh: 无论在家中哪里，我都能够闻到极少量燃气泄漏的气味。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t notice if someone changed their perfume, by smell alone.
prompt.zh: 如果有人换了香水，我无法只凭气味察觉。

prompt.en: I would be able to tell when an elevator/lift started moving.
prompt.zh: 我能够感觉到电梯何时开始移动。

prompt.en: I can hear dog whistles very easily in the park.
prompt.zh: 在公园里，我很容易听见狗哨声。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t taste the difference between different types of lettuce leaves.
prompt.zh: 我尝不出不同种类生菜叶之间的差别。

prompt.en: I couldn’t taste if there were two slices of lemon in my glass of water if I was drinking it with my eyes closed.
prompt.zh: 如果闭着眼睛喝水，即使杯中有两片柠檬，我也尝不出来。

prompt.en: I can’t go out in bright sunlight without sunglasses.
prompt.zh: 没有太阳镜，我无法在明亮的阳光下外出。

prompt.en: I would be able to read small print, such as a serial number on the back of a DVD, at 10 feet (3 metres) away.
prompt.zh: 我能够从10英尺（3米）外读出小字，例如DVD背面的序列号。

prompt.en: I get motion sickness easily (for example, car sickness or sea sickness)
prompt.zh: 我很容易晕动，例如晕车或晕船。

prompt.en: I would be able to feel a change in the temperature of a cup of coffee after it had sat for 1 minute.
prompt.zh: 一杯咖啡放置1分钟后，我能够感觉到它的温度变化。

prompt.en: I can’t hear very low frequency sounds, such as low voices.
prompt.zh: 我听不见很低频率的声音，例如低沉的人声。

prompt.en: I would be the first to hear if there was a fly in the room.
prompt.zh: 如果房间里有苍蝇，我会是第一个听见的人。

prompt.en: If I look at a pile of blue sweaters in a shop that are meant to be identical, I would be able to see differences between them.
prompt.zh: 商店里有一堆本应完全相同的蓝色毛衣，我能够看出它们之间的差别。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t detect a new smell in my house instantly before anyone else.
prompt.zh: 家里出现新气味时，我不会比任何其他人都更早、立刻察觉。

prompt.en: I have perfect pitch: for example, I could repeat a musical tone without any cue.
prompt.zh: 我具有绝对音高：例如，没有任何提示，我也能重复一个乐音。

prompt.en: I would be able to bite into a lemon without any problems.
prompt.zh: 我能够咬一口柠檬而没有任何问题。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t need to wear a coat in the winter, even when it is zero degrees outside.
prompt.zh: 即使冬天室外是零度，我也不需要穿外套。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to match the colour of a sweater in the shop with the colour of my trousers at home.
prompt.zh: 我无法把商店里毛衣的颜色与家中裤子的颜色相匹配。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t hear every single note when listening to music.
prompt.zh: 听音乐时，我无法听见每一个音。

prompt.en: I would be able to smell the difference between most men and women.
prompt.zh: 我能够凭气味区分大多数男性和女性。

prompt.en: I choose to wear muted colours.
prompt.zh: 我会选择穿颜色柔和的衣服。

prompt.en: I listen to music at minimum loudness.
prompt.zh: 我听音乐时会把音量调到最低。

prompt.en: I would be able to hear each note in a chord even if there were 10 notes.
prompt.zh: 即使一个和弦有10个音，我也能够听见其中的每个音。

prompt.en: I close curtains to avoid bright lights.
prompt.zh: 我会拉上窗帘来避开明亮的光。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to hear differences in sound if the same instrument played the same note at different times.
prompt.zh: 同一种乐器在不同时间演奏同一个音时，我听不出声音上的差别。

prompt.en: I would be able to distinguish two brands of coffee by their smell, even with my eyes closed.
prompt.zh: 即使闭着眼睛，我也能够凭气味区分两个品牌的咖啡。

prompt.en: I can see dust particles in the air in most environments.
prompt.zh: 在大多数环境中，我都能看见空气中的尘埃颗粒。

prompt.en: I wouldn’t be able to taste the difference between two brands of tomato sauce if they had different concentrations of salt.
prompt.zh: 如果两个品牌的番茄酱含盐浓度不同，我也尝不出它们之间的差别。

prompt.en: I would be able to smell the smallest amount of burning from anywhere in the house.
prompt.zh: 无论在家中哪里，我都能够闻到极轻微的烧焦气味。

prompt.en: If my mobile phone was vibrating in my pocket I would be quick to sense it.
prompt.zh: 如果口袋里的手机振动，我会很快察觉。

prompt.en: I find it difficult to see individual stars on a clear night.
prompt.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，我很难看清一颗颗星星。
